description:
Read source-linked details for a published Florida boat ramp, marina, fuel dock or waterfront restaurant by exact POI ID returned by a place search. Includes contact details, parking trailer/car/accessible space counts where published, hours, fees, slips, amenities and per-field sources/dates. Launch parking includes 84 collected FWC records and checked operator guidance at selected facilities; launch:notice facts may describe construction or closure and take priority over routine hours/rates. Published capacity is not live availability. Preserve unknown values, source dates and conflicting records. Does not establish current ramp reopening, trailer permission, dock access, live fuel prices or navigable depth. California directory IDs use list_california_facilities; use get_parking_guides for checked California parking guidance.

Units: ft, kt, s, F, mi; directions FROM. Returns data and source/freshness metadata.
name: get_poi_details
title: Get facility details
